def slugify(name: str, *, what: str = "identifier") -> str:
    """Reduce a display name to a lowercase id token (e.g. ``Test User`` -> ``test-user``)."""
    l = _SLUG_PATTERN.sub("-", name.strip().casefold()).strip("-")
